acceptance: Identify the warning class, message text, and origin stack trace emitted during live ClickHouse connection setup under docker
Resolve or suppress the warning at its source if it is an upstream deprecation or expected parameter notice
Live ClickHouse tests run cleanly without triggering the warning in CI or local runs
context: Blamed tests in run 37638195854 and 37794806634 were test_connection and test_create_schema (the first test executed on each xdist worker). Requires Linux with docker compose running at -n 0 so warnings summary is captured.
description: In the t3:docker nightly suite, live ClickHouse connection and schema creation emits a Python warning attributed to benchbox.platforms.clickhouse.setup. Because test teardowns failed with pytrace=False and CI emits no warnings summary, the underlying warning category and message text remain uncaptured. Reproduce on Linux with docker compose at -n 0, inspect the warning, and silence or resolve the source.
